title: Isolated diffuse alveolar hemorrhage as the sole severe manifestation of atypical leptospirosis: diagnostic value of BALF mNGS
summary: Case report demonstrating diagnostic value of BALF metagenomic next-generation sequencing for atypical leptospirosis without classic Weil's syndrome features. Shows mNGS utility in diagnosing rare infectious presentations.
relevance: mNGS clinical application in atypical infections

title: Molecular insights into lower respiratory tract microbiota reveal disease-specific biomarkers in asthma and COPD
summary: Applied BALF genomic sequencing to identify phenotype-specific microbial signatures for asthma and COPD. Demonstrates NGS-based microbiome analysis for respiratory disease biomarker discovery.
relevance: NGS microbiome analysis for respiratory disease

title: AI for Integrated Analysis of Non-Blood Biological Fluids: From Biomarker Discovery to Clinical Decision-Support
summary: Comprehensive review of AI integration in analyzing CSF, serous effusions, and synovial fluid. Covers biomarker discovery, clinical decision-support systems, and multi-omics data integration.
relevance: AI for biological fluid analysis and clinical decision support

title: Evo-RAD: Navigating Rare Retinal Disease Diagnosis via Self-Evolving Agentic Retrieval
summary: Self-evolving agentic retrieval system for rare retinal disease diagnosis. Addresses hubness problem in static retrieval by dynamically adapting retrieval strategies based on query complexity and disease rarity.
relevance: Self-evolving RAG agent for rare disease diagnosis

title: Bridging the Post-discharge Gap: A Traceable Multi-agent Framework for Safe and Continuous Care
summary: Multi-agent framework for post-discharge clinical follow-up with traceable reasoning. Addresses information silos across healthcare settings and enables continuous patient monitoring.
relevance: Multi-agent clinical follow-up with traceable reasoning

title: MedGuard: LLM-based gatekeeper for detecting clinical risks in Chinese telemedicine consultations
summary: First LLM-based agent to monitor telemedicine consultations and proactively flag risks in diagnoses, prescriptions, and clinical dialogs. Includes dedicated workflow and comprehensive benchmark for telemedicine safety.
relevance: LLM agent for telemedicine safety monitoring

title: Enhancing Large Language Model Reasoning with Reward Models: An Analytical Survey
summary: Systematic survey of reward models for LLM reasoning enhancement. Covers RM architectures, training methodologies, applications in RL fine-tuning and inference-time selection. Comprehensive analysis of reward modeling strategies.
relevance: Reward models for LLM reasoning — foundational for medical RLHF

title: Longitudinal benchmarking of AI models for differential diagnosis of oral mucosal lesions
summary: Controlled longitudinal benchmarking of contemporary AI systems for oral mucosal lesion diagnosis. Uses identical biopsy-confirmed dataset to compare diagnostic accuracy across AI systems and specialists.
relevance: AI diagnostic benchmarking — alignment evaluation methodology

title: Large Language Models as Psychotherapists: Analysis Based on Psychodynamic Psychotherapy Theory
summary: Analysis of LLM capabilities and limitations as psychotherapists through psychodynamic psychotherapy lens. Examines interpersonal relationships, unconscious processes, transference/countertransference in LLM interactions.
relevance: LLM alignment challenges in therapeutic contexts

title: Contextualizing Biological Language Models across Modalities via Logit-Space Contrastive Alignment
summary: Novel approach to condition pretrained biological language models on task-specific contexts via logit-space contrastive alignment. Enables PLMs to incorporate interaction partners, cellular contexts, and experimental conditions without retraining.
relevance: Cross-modal conditioning for protein language models

title: Peptide Language Pragmatic Analysis and Two-stage Hierarchical Learning for Therapeutic Peptide Prediction
summary: Two-stage hierarchical learning framework for multi-functional therapeutic peptide prediction. Captures amino acid residue interactions and contextual dependencies through pragmatic language analysis.
relevance: Language model approach for therapeutic peptide design

title: MetaCYP: Unified Framework for Cytochrome P450 Metabolic Site Prediction via Multimodal Deep Learning
summary: Multimodal deep learning framework for predicting CYP-substrate reaction sites and types. Integrates molecular properties with protein sequence information for drug metabolism prediction.
relevance: Protein-language multimodal approach for drug metabolism

title: Rethinking Genomic Modeling Through Optical Character Recognition: OpticalDNA
summary: Novel vision-language approach to genomic modeling that treats DNA as 2D visual representations instead of 1D token sequences. OpticalDNA achieves understanding-driven compression for long genomic contexts, addressing wasted computation on low-information background.
relevance: Vision-language paradigm for genomic foundation models

title: DNATokenizer: GPU-First Byte-to-Identifier Tokenizer for High-Throughput DNA Language Models
summary: GPU-optimized tokenizer for DNA language models that addresses information leakage in overlapping k-mer tokenization. Enables high-throughput genomic processing with improved masked prediction fidelity.
relevance: Efficient tokenization for genomic language models

title: Central Dogma Transformer: Towards Mechanism-Oriented AI for Cellular Understanding
summary: Integrates DNA, RNA, and protein information across the Central Dogma into a unified transformer architecture. Bridges domain-specific foundation models to enable cross-molecular-level cellular understanding.
relevance: Multi-molecular genomic foundation model

title: Pathologist Attention-Aligned Report Generation for Prostate Histopathology
summary: Aligns VLM visual attention with pathologist attention patterns during cancer diagnosis. Addresses the gap between model attention and expert visual reasoning in whole-slide image analysis.
relevance: Expert-aligned multimodal clinical reasoning

title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Understand OCT?
summary: Comprehensive benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on OCT retinal imaging. Goes beyond coarse-grained disease classification to fine-grained anatomical structure understanding and clinical reasoning.
relevance: Multimodal VLM evaluation for ophthalmic imaging

title: Multi-scale Fusion Model for Predicting Pancreatic Cancer Resectability from Multi-phase CECT
summary: Multi-scale fusion model using three-phase contrast-enhanced CT to predict pancreatic cancer resectability. Achieves cross-institutional generalization with multi-center validation.
relevance: Multimodal clinical decision support for surgical planning

title: Large Language Model Agent for Modular Task Execution in Drug Discovery
summary: Modular LLM agent framework for early-stage computational drug discovery. Combines LLM reasoning with domain-specific tools for biomedical data retrieval, molecular generation, and property prediction.
relevance: LLM agent for modular drug discovery pipeline

title: Can Large Language Models Design Biological Weapons? Evaluating Moremi Bio
summary: Evaluates biosecurity risks of LLMs in molecular design. Tests Moremi Bio Agent without safety guardrails for toxic substance generation, providing critical dual-use assessment.
relevance: Biosecurity evaluation of LLM molecular design capabilities

title: BioSage: Cross-Disciplinary Knowledge Retrieval and Synthesis for Scientific Discovery
summary: Compound AI architecture integrating LLMs with RAG and specialized agents for cross-disciplinary discovery across AI, biomedical, and biosecurity domains.
relevance: Cross-disciplinary AI agent for scientific discovery

title: Foundation Models in Biomedical Imaging: Turning Hype into Reality
summary: Critical assessment of foundation models in biomedical imaging, separating practical achievements from hype. Covers deployment challenges, domain adaptation, and real-world clinical integration.
relevance: Foundation model deployment in biomedical imaging
